summary: WEC Energy Group filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an offering of two series of fixed-to-fixed reset rate junior subordinated notes due 2057: Series 2026A resetting in 2032 and Series 2026B resetting in 2037, each with a Treasury-rate-plus-spread reset and a floor equal to the initial rate. Amounts, coupons, and pricing are blank pending completion. The notes are general unsecured, junior subordinated obligations with a 10-year optional interest deferral and issuer redemption rights; no exchange listing is planned. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, spread, and rating-agency equity-credit treatment.
